description: This file defines React components for copying text to clipboard, including a button with icon feedback and styled button with text feedback.

methods.name: CopyToClipboard
methods.description: React component that renders a toolbar button which copies provided text or function result to clipboard and provides icon feedback.

methods.name: CopyToClipboardTextButton
methods.description: React component that renders a styled button which copies provided text or function result to clipboard and shows text feedback.
